text: A six-week older-adult trial found daily walks lowered blood pressure, but only for people not on medication.
Coffee may boost memory, but that's so far only shown in mice given about eight cups a day.
Home workers at a Chinese call-centre firm were 13% more productive, mostly by taking fewer breaks.
A new bridge cut northern commutes by about four minutes, measured during school holidays.
Small mixed-quality trials suggest vitamin D prevents colds, but only in vitamin-D-deficient people.
A four-week reading app helped children with tutors recognize letters, not understand stories.
Lab bees given ten times field pesticide doses made shorter foraging trips but didn't die.
A four-day-week trial in volunteer firms, without a comparison group, cut weekly hours from 38 to 34.
